You keep the timeline of a payments outage. People hand over the incident roles, the severity and the affected services change, mitigation actions run, and the root cause hypothesis changes as evidence comes in.

Initial specification:
- [e001] After the shift change, the incident commander became `gonzaga`, as Hana recorded.
- [e002] Zed wrote in the incident channel that the communications lead is `farouk` from now on.
- [e003] On the bridge call, Ivo handed over, so the operations lead is now `cortes`.
- [e004] Femi reassessed the impact, and the severity of the incident is now `sev-3`.
- [e005] Jun published an update, and the state of the status page is now `investigating`.
- [e006] In the incident channel, Oona reported that `webhook-relay` is among the affected services from now on.
- [e007] In the incident channel, Kira reported that `checkout-web` is among the affected services from now on.
- [e008] In the timeline document, Eli wrote that the start time of the customer impact is `13:41`.
- [e009] In the timeline document, Ivo wrote that the detection time of the incident is `14:03`.
- [e010] Hana reported on the bridge call that the status of the mitigation action act-pause-payouts is now `planned`.
- [e011] Hana updated the action list, and the status of the mitigation action act-revert-deploy became `planned`.
- [e012] Vik reported on the bridge call that the status of the mitigation action act-drain-az2 is now `planned`.
- [e013] Vik updated the action list, and the status of the mitigation action act-block-retries became `planned`.
- [e014] Nils reported on the bridge call that the status of the mitigation action act-failover-db is now `planned`.
- [e015] Sami updated the action list, and the status of the mitigation action act-raise-pool became `planned`.
- [e016] After the log review, the group agreed that the leading root cause hypothesis is `cause-dns-flap`, as Dara recorded.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, hands over, reports, corrects, adds or removes it. A proposal with no decision, a withdrawn draft, a question, a link to a page and an archived copy change nothing.
- A correction or a new entry replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification is the first page of the incident. It gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question. The value "directly before" the current value is the value that the current value replaced.
- Each role has one person at a time. A handover replaces the earlier person.
- The severity is one of `sev-1`, `sev-2`, `sev-3`, `sev-4`. The status page is one of `investigating`, `identified`, `monitoring`, `resolved`. A mitigation action is one of `planned`, `running`, `finished`, `abandoned`.
- A service is affected from the event that adds it until an event removes it. The leading root cause hypothesis has one value at a time. A new hypothesis rules out the earlier one.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
